details:
Q1: Which area should be improved?
Choices:
A. Specify the exact workflow, script, prompt, or file (RECOMMENDED)
B. Clarify/plan/implement pipeline
C. Review/autofix pipeline
D. Orchestrator/validation pipeline
E. Documentation or developer tooling
Q2: What outcome should the change achieve?
Choices:
A. Fix a bug—provide current and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability or performance—provide a measurable target
C. Improve usability or documentation—describe the desired user experience
